description: Learners should be able to describe the business use case and the process of ingesting data, including Specialization Introduction, Introduction to AI Workflow: Business Priorities, Data Ingestion, IBM AI Enterprise Workflow Introduction, Data Collection, Data Ingestion.
Learners should be able to use common techniques such as: EDA, visualization, hypothesis testing and statistical tools, including AI Workflow: Data Analysis, Hypothesis Testing, Data Analysis.

Learners should be able to describe and use common feature selection and feature engineering techniques, including AI Workflow: Feature Engineering, Bias Detection, Data transforms and feature engineering.

Learners should be able to implement the model: machine learning and deep learning algorithms, evaluation and performance metrics, including Model Evaluation, Performance Metrics, Building Machine Learning, Deep Learning Models.

Learners should be able to deploy the model by interacting with Apache Spark then progressing to a tutorial with Docker, including AI Workflow: Enterprise Model Deployment, Deploying Models using Spark.
